correctness.rationale: Stable sets are precisely 2^p+2^q−1 distinct 0–1 vertices in one part or the other. Direct indicator moments yield Σ=(a/2 I+(a/2−a²)J, −ab Jcross; symmetric B block). Orthogonal contrasts have a/2 and b/2, while remaining modes are exact eigenvalues of 2×2 L. Its strictly negative offdiagonal gives simple λ+ larger than either contrast and opposing signed principal-axis blocks. For p=q=k, explicit diagonalization gives λ−=a(1−k/N)/2<a/2; for p>q, the exact determinant det(L−bI/2)=qb[(2^p−1)(2^p−2^q)−p·2^p]/(8N²)>0 and positive first leading minor imply λ−>b/2, so full least eigenspace is B contrasts. Independent exact rational/SymPy evaluation checked this determinant and eigenordering for all 121 profiles 2≤p,q≤12. Scaling a→1/2, b~2^{q−p−1} confirms λ+→1/4 and κ~2^{p−q}. Finite experiments corroborate rather than replace the symbolic inequalities.

value.rationale: Complete spectral classification of a natural graph polytope under a canonical discrete vertex distribution (uniform stable sets), and a sharp discontinuity in least-eigenspace dimension under a one-vertex block perturbation, are meaningful exact geometric-statistical invariants. Explicit exponential anisotropy along unbalanced families differs strongly from uniform-volume behavior; this is more than a single numerical example.

final_claim: Full uniform-vertex Euclidean covariance eigenspectrum of STAB(K_{p,q}), p,q>=2; a sharp global least-eigenvector transition between balanced all-ones direction and smaller-side zero-sum contrasts for any p≠q; balanced κ~k+1 and fixed-smaller-part κ~2^{p−q}.
limitations: No weighted vertex distribution, general multipartite extension, uniform volume, or all affine covariance metrics is claimed.
